en.headline: One-year-old girl dies after being found unresponsive in Kai Tak flat
en.dek: Police were called to a Light Public Housing unit on Olympic Avenue before dawn; the child was sent to Kwong Wah Hospital and later certified dead.
body: A one-year-old girl was certified dead on Thursday after being found unresponsive in a Light Public Housing flat at 20 Olympic Avenue in Kai Tak, police and local media reported.

Officers said a woman called police at about 5.31am to say her daughter had collapsed inside a unit in Block 6. Ambulance crews found the child without breathing or a pulse and took her to Kwong Wah Hospital, where she was later certified dead.

Now News reported that the cause of death would be determined after a post-mortem examination. Relatives attended the hospital to assist officers. Police said they were investigating and have not announced any arrest.

zh.headline: 啟德簡約公屋一歲女嬰昏迷送院不治
zh.dek: 警方清晨接報世運道簡約公屋六座單位有女嬰昏迷，救護員送往廣華醫院搶救後證實不治，死因有待驗屍確定。
body: 一名一歲女嬰周四清晨在啟德世運道20號簡約公屋一個單位被發現昏迷，其後送院不治。
警方表示，約凌晨5晃31分接獲一名女子報案，指其女兒在六座單位內暈倒。救援人員到場發現女嬰沒有呼吸及脈搏，立即送往廣華醫院，其後證實死亡。
Now新聞台報道，死因有待驗屍確定。女嬰親友其後到醫院協助調查。警方正跟進事件，暫時未有公布拘捕行動。
